test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_src (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_src SELECT concat( '{"a":{"b":', toString(number % 100), ',"c":"s', toString(number), '","d":', if(number % 2, 'true', 'false'), ',"e":', toString(number / 7), '},', '"f":{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"k', toString(i), '":"v', toString(number % (i + 3)), '"'), range(12)), ','), '},', '"g":{"h":{"i":', toString(number), ',"j":"', toString(number % 1000), '"}},"l":[1,2,3]}') FROM numbers(300000)
test.query: SELECT s::JSON(max_dynamic_paths=64) FROM json_src FORMAT Null
SELECT s::JSON(max_dynamic_paths=0) FROM json_src FORMAT Null
